known_limitations.backtest_engine_not_full_decision_replay: BacktestEngine is NOT a historical replay of live DecisionEngine. It evaluates technical_score only and does not reconstruct historical news/macro channel scores. Technical V1 validation results must not be described as 'full DecisionEngine validation' or 'full AL/SAT system out-of-sample performance'.
known_limitations.external_data_revisions_note: The data-provider/completion contract (BIST calendar, completed-bar filtering, session normalization) is pinned by methodology_git_commit where implemented in code, but the external Yahoo Finance OHLCV values themselves are NOT pinned by git and may be silently revised by the provider after the fact. Current provider history must not be treated as immutable.
